items.evidence: Notes: "Remote control design kickoff" with "Original, trendy, user friendly" and later "Only TV remote control, no multi-device".

Names appear only in the action items (Mark, Xavier, User Interface Designer, Dirk) and the marketing expert is mentioned once; the notes never state the team makeup or what each role is looking at (user needs, usability, engineering and materials).

Notes: "Three-phase design approach", "Functional design first phase", "Individual work then group meetings". Transcript frames it as three phases of design with functional design first, which the notes match.
Notes: "Electronic whiteboard introduction", "Pen tool, erase, color, line width", "Use for presentations and sharing", plus "Share meeting minutes and project files".
Notes: "Drawing demo of animals for creativity" and the Design Inspirations section listing dolphin, elephant, tiger, ant.
Notes: "Usability and inclusivity discussed", "Intuitive design, accessible for disabled users", "Material should be light".
Answer key has no action items. The notes do list action items; those are assessed in the errors list.
Notes: "Product scope clarified", "Only TV remote control, no multi-device".
Notes say only "Intuitive design". Missing the key point from the UI designer at 11:34 that the design must stick to what people are familiar with, with no radical changes.
Notes: "accessible for disabled users" under "Usability and inclusivity discussed". Transcript: PM says to take it into consideration (12:16).
Notes: "Material should be light" (industrial designer at 12:33, PM agrees at 12:43).

errors.claim: Mark Knopp: Provide personal assignments to team members (13:53)
errors.why_wrong: At 13:25 the project manager says the personal coach will give the personal assignments, not him.

errors.claim: Xavier Juukens: Address material considerations for lightweight design (12:00)
errors.why_wrong: The industrial designer only suggested the material should be light; no one assigned or agreed to a task. Assignments come from the personal coach.

errors.claim: User Interface Designer: Prepare intuitive design concepts (11:20)
errors.why_wrong: The UI designer raised intuitive design as a point to keep in mind; no task was agreed in the meeting.
The UI designer tied the dolphin to freedom only. "Sure looks smooth" was the PM's comment on the tiger drawing (08:13), not a dolphin trait.
The transcript gives the project manager's name only as Mark; the surname Knopp does not appear anywhere.
